limitations: Static screenshots do not prove playback or audio; real playback and Range checks are in browser-after-1/report.json.
Paused native preview/render spinners occur in both baseline and after captures; they limit frame-level visual assessment of those particular paused screenshots.
Dialog placement is inherited from baseline; no behavioral redesign was performed.
This reviewer inspected five after images, four before images and three diagnostic fixture images, not every image in the evidence directory.
No human auditory evaluation, physical-device test or complete WCAG certification is claimed.
Images document the earlier live browser run; runtime status on the resumed turn is separately recorded by primary agent.
